reason: The new `await _adminThemeService?.GetAdminThemeNameAsync()` pattern still throws a NullReferenceException when IAdminThemeService is null (awaiting a null Task doesn't short-circuit), so sites without the Admin feature enabled—the exact scenario this PR claims to fix—will still crash in LayerFilter on every request.
